{{Quote|I'm not the only one who's been waiting...|Quarris|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Quarris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal living during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]], Quarris worked for [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] and was in the group criminals were ordered to kill the [[Voidhound]] and bring his remains to the [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]]. Quarris cornered the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] on [[Port Nowhere]] and brought Rogun in through the holotransmission, but was unable to best the Voidhound and was killed in the fight.
